profile.headline: Web Designer at "HOLDSTILL!"​ Productions Small Business Website Design SEO & Stock Photography
profile.summary:
USA Small Business Website Design & SEO + Stock Photography Since 2001 Our past experiences in the business world prepared us for the many avenues of what makes a small business successful. Knowing what goes on, budgets, sales or no sales, insurance rates & employee relations all allow us to build a website that uniquely fits that small business owner. We also market Your website to as many free directories as are available personally and ensure all pages are SEO coded to reflect the product or service being offered or sold. Our antiques business since 1998 has prepared us for e-commerce  on your website or on eBay & PayPal.  Your success is our success because we are also a small business.

Specialties: unique websites for small business, budget friendly prices, SEO and marketing, Photoshop retouch & websized images, professional photography, logos, daily updates, one-to-one personal service

company.name: "HOLDSTILL!"​ Productions™ Small Business Website Design SEO & Stock Photos

positions.title: Owner - Webmaster, Web Developer, SEO, Marketing, Sole Proprietor, Woman Owned & Operated.
positions.description:
Designing websites for small business is what I enjoy doing because it is helping people be successful in what they have invested their lives and their finances and their well-being. This year we have excellent new software that allows us to design anything you may want in or on your website. We are excited to provide our own created templates (no we do not need to purchase a template) that reflect your business and only your business. We can also take any photos you supply & turn them into your logo or fix them for a portfolio or an illustration of what your business provides whether products or services. If we need something you don't have we search our own stock photos to find the perfect background or sky or whatever is needed. We also provide Form Mail w/captchas that reflect the questions you want asked so you know how to answer your customer plus emails are protected. All pages are search engine ready for the topic of that particular page. You always get screenshots so you can change anything before we publish plus we will make any changes throughout the 1st year for free after you pay our package fee. The following year, changes or updates start at $6.00 - $25.00 depending on what you want us to do. There is no yearly or monthly fee for the website - just any changes you may make after the 1st year. We also let you pay on time if need be although our package fees are budget priced.
Our clients are from all over the USA & are all small businesses that depend on their webmaster to handle renewals w/hosting companies, other computer problems, business questions & more and I am glad to be able to have enough experience to help them or research their problem so they can relax & get back to running their own business. And that is why I like what I do. DAJ

positions.title: Sole Proprietor Online Antiques Dealer
positions.description: 100tonsofstuff.com Is SOLELY located in Virginia & has NO employees.It is the estate of my antique dealer parents whose shop was located several places in VA until their passing in 1980. In 1996- 1998 a personal website was designed to sell this large estate and in 2000 a domain was purchased and a business website was designed to sell these items online. There has never been a retail shop for this estate. All items are being sold online to buyers in the USA and Internationally by us. This estate is so large that no items have ever been purchased and all the items in the estate have still not been listed for sale because we are still going through boxes and finding stuff that need better identification and pricing. My parents had an antique shop from 1953 to 1980 plus they collected and saved everything. You would be amazed at what I have sold that most people would have thrown away. And BTW: I don't "work here" - I own all this 100tonsofstuff !

company.name: 100 Tons of Stuff To Sell - Estate of Antiques Dealer in VA

positions.title: Owner - Sole Proprietor
positions.description: In 1985 we became Professional Photographers offering our service via Freelance. We also accumulated over 25,000 stock photography images (which we now use in our web design business). We used to supply stock photography to newspapers, magazines & book publishers. When digital cameras became good enough for others to supply their own stock images we decided to supply our photo services to the local businesses when we designed their website. We will photograph your shop & products if you are in the metro Richmond, Va area. If you are not, you may send us a CD so we can edit your images. We also offer scanning services for $25.00 per hour of prints - B&W or color plus we spot them & enhance them & deliver them by CD. Let us know how we can help you. Dianne

volunteerExperiences.role: Cancer Survivor 2011 & runner & again in 2015 - update
volunteerExperiences.companyName: Relay for Life in Ashland, VA & Cancer Treatment Again
volunteerExperiences.description:
After my breast cancer operation in Sept 2011 & chemo & radiation ending in April 2012, I decided to participate at the Relay for Life in Ashland, VA in May 2012. There were many cancer survivors including some who were still going through chemo & radiation. This is an excellent cause and I encourage every one to get a mammogram before age 40 so you will have a before picture for the doctors to compare plus younger women are getting cancer. The mammogram is free now at most hospitals - please do get one sooner than later. You may save your breast and save your life. I waited too long and was at stage 3 without knowing it. Am well now, praise the Lord!
UPDATE June 2015: Without warning I cracked a rib, had an x-ray which showed nothing, had a CT scan that showed bone cancer that had spread from my breast cancer lymph nodes in 2012. Thank God for the cracked rib as my cancer doctor didn't catch it by doing the blood test CT127-29 in December - Jan. even tho it was elevated. Many scans later & clinical trial drugs plus XGVA (Prolia) shots every month & I am now about 89% or better. Both kinds of treatment knocked the cancer from invading further & I am on a long term healing process (bones heal slowly). And I feel good. So good that I have been well enough to take care of a huge vegetable garden & can lots of veggies all summer (2015). The XGVA shots are stronger than Prolia & very expensive. I had to get help for the co-pay from an organization that funds treatments like this. Am very thankful there are people who are willing to help with expenses like this.

volunteerExperience.role: Cancer Survivor 2011 & runner & again in 2015 - update
volunteerExperience.companyName: Relay for Life in Ashland, VA & Cancer Treatment Again
volunteerExperience.description:
After my breast cancer operation in Sept 2011 & chemo & radiation ending in April 2012, I decided to participate at the Relay for Life in Ashland, VA in May 2012. There were many cancer survivors including some who were still going through chemo & radiation. This is an excellent cause and I encourage every one to get a mammogram before age 40 so you will have a before picture for the doctors to compare plus younger women are getting cancer. The mammogram is free now at most hospitals - please do get one sooner than later. You may save your breast and save your life. I waited too long and was at stage 3 without knowing it. Am well now, praise the Lord!
UPDATE June 2015: Without warning I cracked a rib, had an x-ray which showed nothing, had a CT scan that showed bone cancer that had spread from my breast cancer lymph nodes in 2012. Thank God for the cracked rib as my cancer doctor didn't catch it by doing the blood test CT127-29 in December - Jan. even tho it was elevated. Many scans later & clinical trial drugs plus XGVA (Prolia) shots every month & I am now about 89% or better. Both kinds of treatment knocked the cancer from invading further & I am on a long term healing process (bones heal slowly). And I feel good. So good that I have been well enough to take care of a huge vegetable garden & can lots of veggies all summer (2015). The XGVA shots are stronger than Prolia & very expensive. I had to get help for the co-pay from an organization that funds treatments like this. Am very thankful there are people who are willing to help with expenses like this.
